name: Pattern 6: Value Specification
description: Represents the data values attached to Information Content Entities: any value from the other patterns is linked to its ICE with the nfdicore:hasValue data property. For measurement data the measured value is given with hasValue while the corresponding unit is linked to an instance of iao:MeasurementUnitLabel.
competency_questions: What value was measured for a given property of a sample, and in which unit is it reported?; Which recorded measurements describe one and the same property of the same object, so that their numbers can be compared?; Which recorded results are reported in a particular unit, for example in megapascals?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
